Viz.js 3.31.0 (`@viz-js/viz`, MIT): Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly, for drawings on the
board (```dot). `viz-global.js` is the package's `dist/viz-global.js`, unchanged. It contains, in
object code form, Graphviz (https://www.graphviz.org, Eclipse Public License 1.0) and Expat
(https://libexpat.github.io, MIT). https://github.com/mdaines/viz-js
